rubric_hint.rule: 5 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, 2.64 ha polygon, Härryda; 0% overlap with completed fellings, so not already felled.
No eligible species within 250 m (only mobile NT birds and a moose, supporting evidence at most). The rubric hint reports 5 eligible species beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, giving MEDIUM.

Within 500 m, three eligible site-bound species were recorded, all at 478 m, uncertainty 25 m, all dated 2016: EN lichen Gyalecta ulmi, VU lichen Gyalecta flotowii, EN fungus Steccherinum robustius. Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, old/large trees or dead wood.
Effort is above the county median (1075 records vs 75; 90th percentile). Near-site, 88 records and 17 species were found within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The eligible records are about 10 years old and 478 m away; they may not reflect the current stand.
I did not inspect the two further eligible species the hint counts between 500 and 1000 m (5 in total).
Forest type is given only as 'Normal skog'.
not_established: Whether any threatened species occupies the felling site.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of records inside the polygon does not show absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should check the 2016 lichen and fungus record locations (about 478 m away) and their habitat, and consider whether the stand has similar features, such as old or large trees and dead wood, before felling.
